method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search for available Storyblok API endpoints. Returns the top 3 matching operations with their operationId, summary, and behavior.

Always use this first when you don't know which operation to call. Then call `describe` with the operationId to get all parameters, request body schema, and the `executeWith` field that tells you which execute tool to call.

query.description: Search query. Use keywords — results are ranked by how many match. Synonyms like 'fetch'/'retrieve'→get, 'remove'→delete, 'add'→create, 'edit'/'modify'→update are resolved automatically. (e.g., 'publish story', 'fetch asset', 'remove component')

tools.name: describe
tools.description:
Get full details for a Storyblok API operation. Returns all parameters (path, query) with descriptions and schemas, the request body schema for write operations, available response fields, the `executeWith` tool name to call next, and a `requiresRegion` flag when the user's region must be confirmed before executing.

Always call this after `search` and before executing.

operationId.description: The operationId to describe (from search results)

tools.name: execute_readonly
tools.description: Execute a read-only Storyblok API operation (behavior: 'readOnly'). Supports pagination via `page` and `per_page`; check `pagination.total_pages` in response.

operation.description: The operation ID to execute (from search results)

region.description: Storyblok region — only provide when `describe` shows `requiresRegion: true`. Auto-detected from space_id otherwise.

fields.description: Response fields to return using dot notation (e.g., ["stories.id", "stories.name"]). See `responseFields` in `describe` result. Omit for full response.

tools.name: execute_mutating
tools.description: Execute a mutating Storyblok API operation (behavior: 'idempotent' or unset).

operation.description: The operation ID to execute (from search results)

region.description: Storyblok region — only provide when `describe` shows `requiresRegion: true`. Auto-detected from space_id otherwise.

tools.name: execute_destructive
tools.description: Execute a destructive Storyblok API operation (behavior: 'destructive'). Data may be permanently lost.

operation.description: The operation ID to execute (from search results)

region.description: Storyblok region — only provide when `describe` shows `requiresRegion: true`. Auto-detected from space_id otherwise.

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.description: Create an asset record in Storyblok and get a signed S3 upload URL. Returns a ready-to-use curl command for environments with shell access (Claude Code, Cursor), or a Storyblok asset manager link for manual upload. After the file is uploaded to S3, call `upload_asset_finish` to finalize the asset.

asset_folder_id.description: ID of the asset folder to upload into

region.description: Storyblok region (eu, us, cn, ap, ca). Do NOT provide this parameter by default — it is auto-detected from space_id. Only provide it when the operation description explicitly asks you to.

tools.name: upload_asset_finish
tools.description: Finalize an asset upload after the file has been uploaded to S3 externally. Call this after using a signed S3 URL (from `upload_asset`) to complete the upload via curl or manual upload.

region.description: Storyblok region (eu, us, cn, ap, ca). Do NOT provide this parameter by default — it is auto-detected from space_id. Only provide it when the operation description explicitly asks you to.
